subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Know the features of a good advert.
Use imperatives and adjectives in an advert.
Plan, write and check your own advert.

tf.s: A slogan is a short, catchy sentence for an advert.
tf.why: Yes, like See the sea in the city!

tf.s: The slogan of City Beach Aquarium is “See the sea in the city!”
Adverts use bullet points to make information clear and easy to read.
tf.why: Yes, bullet points are short and clear.

tf.s: A logo is a long story about the place.
tf.why: A logo is a picture or symbol for the place.

tf.s: “Our museum.” is a good, exciting slogan.
tf.why: It is not exciting; try Discover the past today!

tf.s: Visit, Watch and Learn are imperatives.
tf.why: They tell the reader what to do.

tf.s: Amazing and exciting are adjectives that make adverts interesting.
A good advert should not tell people how to buy tickets.
tf.why: Important information, like tickets, helps readers.

tf.s: “See amazing animals from all over the world!” is better than “You can see animals.”
tf.why: It uses an imperative and an exciting adjective.

tf.s: After writing, we never check our advert.
tf.why: We plan, write, check and rewrite.

boxes.q: ___ through the glass tunnel and see sharks.
boxes.why: Imperatives start with the base verb.

boxes.q: Complete the aquarium slogan: See the sea in the ___!
boxes.why: See the sea in the city!
A logo is the place's symbol.
An offer gives you something extra or cheaper.

boxes.q: Which adjective makes an advert exciting?
Which is a good slogan for a theme park?
Which bullet point uses an imperative?

boxes.why: Short points are easy to read.

boxes.q: Two stars and a wish means two good things and ___.
boxes.why: The wish is a helpful suggestion.

hunt.q: Short catchy line in an advert
Picture or symbol for a place

mcq.q: What is the slogan of City Beach Aquarium?
o: See the sea in the city!

mcq.q: Which list shows features of a good advert?
o: logo, slogan, bullet points, special offer
a diary date and first person
mcq.why: These features make adverts clear and persuasive.

mcq.q: What are the steps of writing?
mcq.why: Plan first, then write, check and rewrite.

mcq.q: Which word is an imperative from the aquarium advert?
mcq.why: Relax, visit, walk, take, watch and learn are imperatives.

mcq.q: Improve this sentence: You can see animals.
o: See amazing animals from all over the world!
mcq.why: Use an imperative and an exciting adjective.

mcq.q: Which pair of imperatives fits a science museum advert?
o: Visit our space room! Watch amazing experiments!
We have a room. It has experiments.
mcq.why: Imperatives invite the reader to act.

mcq.q: Which is the best special offer for an advert?
o: Special offer: children under five go free!
mcq.why: An offer gives the reader a good deal.

o: No, it is not exciting. A slogan should be short and catchy.
No, because it has no phone number.
mcq.why: A slogan must be catchy, e.g. Discover the past today!

mcq.q: Why do adverts use bullet points?
o: To make information short, clear and easy to read
To make the text very long
To show the date of a diary

mcq.q: A partner's advert has a clear logo and fun slogan but no opening times. What is a good wish?
o: Next time, add the opening times.
mcq.why: A wish suggests how to improve.
